summary: End-to-end testing of Rebild Client Portal MVP. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (auth, admin client CRUD, invoices, broadcast updates, tickets w/ admin reply, notifications, role enforcement, password reset, seeded services/addons). Frontend: login (admin+client), admin dashboard, sidebar nav, create client (generated password shown), create invoice, post broadcast update, notifications dropdown, profile menu + logout, client login redirect, full client sidebar (Dashboard/Services/Add-ons/Invoices/Updates/Reports/Support/Profile), client sees issued invoice (INV-...), support page, and mobile drawer (375x800) all work.

minor.issue: One-off 503 'upstream connect error' observed during first run; reproducible only intermittently and clears on retry.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting implemented (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails).

issues: Dark obsidian sidebar + light content area renders cleanly, branding 'Rebild' visible with orange accent. No contrast issues observed.

action_items: (Optional, security hardening) Add brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login per auth playbook.
(Optional) Investigate transient 503 from ingress on cold start — likely infra, not app code.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 835 lines — consider splitting into routers/<resource>.py modules (auth, clients, invoices, updates, tickets, addons, notifications) for maintainability.
CORS uses single FRONTEND_URL with allow_credentials=True (correct), but CORS_ORIGINS env var in backend/.env is set to '*' and unused — remove dead config to avoid confusion.
Auth cookie set with secure=True + SameSite=None requires HTTPS; OK for preview. Add CSRF protection for state-changing endpoints if cookie auth is primary.
verify_password silently returns False on any exception (could hide bcrypt format bugs); log at debug level instead of swallow.
Seed admin updates password if env changed (idempotent) — good.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projection / doc_clean — good.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@rebild.com / Rebild@2026 (seeded). Test clients are created on demand by tests; generated_password returned from POST /api/admin/clients.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_/uitest_/final_ prefixed clients and delete them in teardown. Default services (5) and add-ons (4) are auto-seeded by backend on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_rebild_portal.py for regression. All admin and client flows verified including auth, CRUD, role enforcement, broadcast updates, and tickets. To re-test UI: login as admin, create client via Clients > New client, close credentials modal via [data-testid='modal-close'] (important — modal blocks further nav until closed), then proceed. Notifications dropdown / profile dropdown each render a fixed inset-0 overlay z-30; close them by clicking the overlay, not Escape.
rca of the issue: N/A — no application bugs found. Initial test-script failures (invoice nav, logout) were due to leftover modal overlay from credentials modal blocking subsequent sidebar clicks; resolved by using [data-testid='modal-close']. App functionality is correct.
